Commentary.Commentary: A disappointing show with the ball for England. They were never in the game, apart for a small while after the rain break and struggled. Willey and Rashid picked up 2 wickets apiece with the latter making a good comeback after going for plenty early on. We hear that the D/L/S target for England is 308. Should be an exciting run chase...

In what can be called as the most frustrating pair from England's point of view, Mathews and Chandimal stood firm again, with an 87-run stand for the 4th wicket. Chandimal departed but Mathews stayed till the end, taking the score past 300. The last 8 overs went for 70, which showed an excellent performance at the death.

It was not the greatest of starts by the visitors. They lost Kusal Perera due to a mix-up, but then Gunathilaka and Mendis fought back bravely. Then the rain arrived and when play resumed, both set batsmen were dismissed in the space of 23 balls. England were rushing through their overs and it seemed like Sri Lanka would lose their way again.

That is an excellent score posted by the Sri Lankans. Do not forget, a few more runs would be added to this total due to the D/L/S method coming into play. The Lankans have batted well and put themselves in a terrific position to win and level the series.

OUT! That is a terrific catch from Moeen Ali! Wow. He missed a slightly difficult chance in his previous over but on this occasion he has taken what can be called as a blinder. Gunathilaka was trying to step down the track, aiming to go inside out and Rashid smartly followed him. He cramped the batsman for room and as a result, Gunathilaka could not get enough wood on the shot. He ended up slicing it over extra cover but Moeen Ali rushed across to his right from mid off and took a very, very good catch. Both the set batsmen dismissed in a quick space of time. Back to the Mathews-Chandimal pair again to resurrect the innings.

Hello and a warm welcome to the 4th ODI between England and Sri Lanka at The Oval. Three matches in and there has been only one conclusive result -  a win for England. Expect the visitors to give it their all in today's match to win in this crucial game.
